You are the Sol xhigh OFFLINE code/build worker. Workspace /home/regex/work/esp32s31-openvela. Root owns all board/UART/USB/Windows/network/credentials and restoration. No hardware or network operations. No new agents. Read root README and applicable instructions. User requests only numbered xTS FS/Wi-Fi performance convergence to existing stock IDF measurements; reduce negative costs when above reference, no weakened guards/security/durability. Preserve maintained dirty trees, frozen artifacts, SDK/HAL locks. No upgrade/download/git checkout/reinit/push.

Implement the already reviewed independent MIN_MODEM experiment, OFFLINE ONLY: read backups/xts-adaptation-and-test-evidence/korvo-default-reference-followup/power-save-cost-review.md. Base exact frozen E87 korvo-tcp-listener-backlog. E94 runtime TCP32000 screen already6.175/5.275Mbps > reference~2.8 each. Current E87 selects ESP_POWER_SAVE_NONE; create isolated B whose ONLY semantic config difference is NONE off/MIN_MODEM on (MAX remainsoff). Preserve BGN/STA_11AX off, IOB256, buffers/BA6, all clocks/IRQs/security/credential behavior/watchdogs/timeouts, disconnectedPM, sleep50/10/15 values, E87backlog. Do not merge E88UDPtail, E86 application, newFSstdio, AX or power-management/DFS/light-sleep changes. TCP32000 remains Root's runtime workload, not source/config change.

Write all new files only below backups/xts-adaptation-and-test-evidence/korvo-network-min-modem-reference. Reuse existing locked build machinery from korvo-network-11ax-reference/build-tools where appropriate, but bind exact E87 source and pair explicitly. First examine actual receipts/code to choose smallest safe reuse, not blind paths. No board runner needed in this task. Do not edit copied implementation source: config-only. If single-variable preservation impossible, report blocker rather than addchanges. No artificial firmware performance claims. Preserve same-build kernel/AppFS/config and make paired artifact hashes/sizes reproducible. Audit config/header differences, source sameness, actual compiled DEFAULT_PS_MODE/call to setter changes0→1 where feasible, source/library identities and kernel text/data/BSS. Full clean build for B with existing dependencies/toolchain; avoid rebuilding known A solely for repetition if E87 receipt sufficient. No implementation-mirroring tests for simpleconfig; build/audit is appropriate. Historical logs/artifacts remain untouched.

Deliver concise README.md, receipt.json and paired-artifacts.json, precise provenance/config/source differences and build output, plus safe isolated patch/config recipe. Clearly B is unmeasured and policy selection does not prove electrical savings or working sleep/wakeup. Root will review then decide bounded board screen separately; do not create extra approval questions. This work is independent of the current AX failure investigation; don't wait for its result or switch to HE fixes. Limit searches to necessary files, avoid massive copied-library scans/full source diffs if recorded hashes and compiled manifests answer the question.

I’ll inspect the E87 receipts and locked build scripts, then build the isolated MIN_MODEM variant and audit its config, source identities, and paired artifacts. All work will stay offline and under the requested evidence directory.

I’m using the xTS evidence skill for build pairing and evidence classification, within the offline-only scope. The review calls for the existing Kconfig choice: NONE off, MIN_MODEM on, with runtime testing left to Root.

The build helpers are at the top of `korvo-network-11ax-reference`; there is no `build-tools/` subdirectory. They target E88, so I’ll reuse only the locked offline build mechanics and bind them explicitly to E87. I’ll keep E87’s source and defconfig unchanged and seed the build from its frozen expanded config, preserving backlog=1 while changing the PS choice.

E87’s recorded kernel, AppFS, config, and compiled inputs verify against disk. Its frozen pair is sufficient for A, so I won’t rebuild it. The source copy is in progress; B will get a fresh build directory, with the inherited network guard and temporary files confined to the new evidence directory.

B’s full clean build passed. The resolved config has exactly the two PS choice toggles, and the generated header changes only NONE to MIN_MODEM. I’ll now compare compiled inputs, libraries, objects, and section sizes, and verify that the compiled setter argument changes from 0 to 1.

The audit passed: all 2,358 compiled source identities and normalized compile commands match E87. Of 3,313 objects, five differ: the adapter’s setter instruction, two timestamp-bearing objects, and two diagnostic path strings. Kernel text, data, and BSS sizes are unchanged; read-only data grows by 8 bytes. I’m sealing the hashes and reproduction recipe now. B remains unmeasured.

The pair and receipts are sealed, and all 84 checksum entries verify. The README includes the preservation audit, size results, paired hashes, and a recipe that refuses to overwrite delivered outputs. Root can review B for a later board screen; there are no runtime or electrical-saving results.

Completed offline B from exact frozen E87. Full clean build and audits passed; all 84 checksum entries verified.

Only the PS choice changes NONE→MIN_MODEM; compiled setter argument is 0→1. Code/data/BSS sizes are unchanged; read-only data grows 8 B.
